decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core pump portfolio with likely shared components, sales channels, and service capabilities, it remains a relatively cheap option to keep open while the firm gathers more evidence on sustained demand.

Although uptake is still uncertain and the product is somewhat less central than the firm's traditional machinery, it supports the strategic move toward digitalized and interoperable customer solutions, so preserving the option to learn is still worthwhile.

Because this hydraulic two-component spraying system is newly launched, close to the established offer, and has not yet had enough time to reveal its full market value, management would usually continue it for another year rather than abandon the option prematurely.
